decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric, shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and to material, colour, texture and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by any condition(s) attached to this consent.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (270, 271, 272, 280, 281, 282, 283 & 284 Received: 02 June 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The re-instated grille on the south-western elevation of The Grotto shall fix into existing holes unless details otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Repairs to the Grotto and East Arch Wall at Gunnersbury Park.
